# Shield

> Sovereign Client-Side Secret Shielding & Fail-Closed Wire Guard for AI Agents.

## Core Capabilities
- Deterministic Secret Tokenization: Replaces sensitive credentials with fixed-width cryptographic placeholders (`[SECRET_REF_...]`) before transmission to cloud LLMs (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI).
- Fail-Closed Wire Guard: Hardware/transport-level pre-flight scan that halts outbound HTTP calls if an unmasked secret slips into network egress buffers.
- Shannon Entropy Scanning: Detects raw high-entropy strings (>4.2 bits/char) to catch unformatted keys and credentials.
- Invisible Unicode Smuggling Defense: Strips zero-width spaces (`\u200b`, `\u200c`, `\ufeff`) used in evasion attacks.
- AST Reassembly & Verification: Validates syntax of generated code using language ASTs (`go/parser`) to prevent token corruption.
- Loopback Proxy: Zero-code drop-in proxy on `127.0.0.1:8080` for Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf.

## CLI Usage
- `shield proxy --port 8080`: Starts local loopback proxy.
- `shield redact "<text>"`: Manually redacts strings or files.
- `shield verify --file <path>`: Verifies syntactic validity of de-tokenized code.

## Endpoints & Documentation
- Proxy Endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions`
- Documentation: `docs/knowledge-base/06-shield.md` in repo `spanreed`
